{{Quote|It's been a long day, my friend. I'm doing what I came here to do—don't make me kill you first.|Anri to [[Dol Narlock]]|<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
'''Anri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who served during the [[Third Galactic War]]. She was in command of [[Raven Squad]].

==Biography==
As a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]],<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> Anri rose through the ranks of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] due to societal reforms proposed by [[Darth Malgus]] and continued by [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> By the time of the Third Galactic War, she became a major in command of Raven Squad, a highly esteemed [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|special forces]] unit serving under [[Darth Malora]] and then [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> Anri belonged to the 8 percent of [[Alien/Legends|Non-Human]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] that staffed the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the third Galactic War.<ref name="Anri">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Major Anri}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:AnriBattle.png|thumb|250px|During the Invasion of Ossus.]]
Anri viewed her advancement in the meritocratic terms of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at large; one's power and standing rises as they prove their superiority by overcoming the threats and impediments facing them. Her skillful leadership and gallows humor made her popular with her fellow [[Raven Squad|troops]], and while her outspokenness led some officers and Sith to question her dedication, her [[Raven Squad|troops]] knew firsthand that her determination to see the Sith Empire triumph over all foes was absolute.<ref name="Anri" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Anri was first introduced in Patch 5.10.0 of ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', dubbed ''Jedi Under Siege''. She is available as a companion NPC to the [[Alliance Commander|main character]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> She is voiced by [[Helen Sadler]],<ref name="Twitter Sadler">{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1074731639853453312|[[Charles Boyd]]|quote=And @helensadler as Major Anri! Tough and funny and warm and deadly in equal measures is not an easy thing to do at all, but Helen made it look easy.|archivefile=File:CharlesBoyd-AnriUpdate-December-17-2018.png}}</ref> who previously worked on ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' as Jedi Master [[Surro]]. According to [[Charles Boyd]], the Creative Director for the game, Anri is an updated version of a character that he originally wrote years prior to the release of ''Jedi Under Siege''; an antagonist in the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic Trooper]] storyline who was cut from the final release of the game.<ref name="Twitter Anri">{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1074732238602932225|[[Charles Boyd]]|quote=Anri is an updated version of a character that I originally wrote years ago, an antagonist for the Trooper storyline that never made it in. So it was a real pleasure finally seeing her in game with such a great performance.|archivefile=File:CharlesBoyd-AnriUpdate-December-17-2018.png}}</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
For Republic players during the [[Mek-Sha]] storyline, Anri is confronted by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice-Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]] attempting to activate the station's failsafe. If the player is a Loyalist, Anri immediately surrenders, not wanting to take her chances against the one who defeated the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="Onslaught" /> The player will later receive a message from Narlock, stating that Anri had escaped his most secure ship, the ''[[Aphelion III]]''.<ref name="Escape">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Escaped Prisoner|Vice Admiral Narlock}}</ref> Alternatively, if the player is a Saboteur, they have the choice of either killing Narlock and allowing Anri to activate the failsafe, or assist Narlock.<ref name="Onslaught" />

For Imperial players, Anri will once again accompany the player during the [[Mission to Mek-Sha|mission]] to sabotage the Republic fleet refueling on [[Mek-Sha]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] in order to destroy the Republic's advanced [[Meridian Complex]] shipyard,<ref name="Onslaught" /> and later the [[Invasion of Manaan]] in order to seize [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] for the Empire and oppose the Republic's [[Binexan-class Destroyer|''Binexan''-class Destroyer]].<ref name="Legacy of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

If the player is a [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]], they can relate to Anri when asking about her opinions on the Empire working with the slaver zealots of the [[The Brothers|Brothers]] on Mek-Sha.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Anri and the Imperial player reunite on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] when [[Darth Krovos]] sends her as an attaché to join the player and [[Talos Drellik]] in investigating the newly-unearthed [[Darth Nul's Laboratory|laboratory]] of [[Darth Nul]]. When [[Darth Nul's holocron]] is placed into an antiquated droid, it automatically begins sending out a data transmission, and she and Talos disagree over whether or not to destroy the droid in order to stop it. If the player chooses to let the transmission continue in order to gain more information from the holocron, Anri will shoot the droid anyway.<ref name="The Library of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>

Anri and the Imperial player reunite once again on [[Odessen]] when she and [[Darth Rivix]] join the procession of [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] or [[Darth Vowrawn|Emperor Vowrawn]] and the [[Dark Council]], and witnesses the Empire's rulers confront the player over their possession of Darth Nul's holocron and place the planet on lockdown. Anri supports the player when they plot to sneak off of Odessen in order to meet with the reemerged [[Darth Jadus]], but grows suspicious when Darth Rivix orders her to stay behind. Trusting her own intuition, Anri follows the player and Rivix to their meeting point with Jadus on the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']], where her instincts are proven correct when she arrives just in time to rescue the player after having been betrayed and left for dead by Jadus and Rivix. She and the player then prepare to return to Odessen to marshal their forces to travel to [[Khar Shian]] in order to confront their enemies.<ref name="Masters Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|[[Odessen]] and the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]}}</ref>

Upon returning to Odessen, Anri will defend the player to the Empress or Emperor and help convince everyone to work together to prepare for the coming [[Battle of Khar Shian]]. During the battle, Anri will pilot Darth Krovos's [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]], the ''Stygian Talon'', in space while the player confronts their enemies on the ground in [[Naga Sadow's fortress]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

===Romance===
Anri can be flirted with by Imperial players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]] at several points during ''Jedi Under Siege'', as well as several points during ''Onslaught'' and ''Legacy of the Sith'', which can potentially culminate in a kiss at the end of the Manaan storyline. Afterward, she will send the player romantic messages via mail after key points in the plot. She and the player can flirt during their reunion on Elom and before the player's mission to the ''Enigma'', and they can potentially share two more kisses before returning to Odessen.<ref name="Masters Enigma" />
